The vault does not rank VNA opportunities, so the strongest opportunities below are the ones with the clearest combination of wireless-market demand, measurement need, and VNA/R&S product evidence rather than a verified ranking [44][43][48][65].
### 推薦先賣
1. Higher frequencies / mmWave / early 6G network infrastructure is the clearest VNA opportunity because the network-infrastructure solution mapping explicitly lists R&S ZNA and R&S ZNA67EXT for “Higher frequencies / mmWave / early 6G,” alongside mmWave front ends and frequency converters [43].  
2. Wireless regulatory and certification labs are a strong VNA opportunity because wireless products require approval testing for market access, and the regulatory-test source lists “network analyzer” among primary test instruments for wireless regulatory test labs [26][27][48].  
3. LEO satellite terminals, phased-array antennas, and high-frequency RF validation are a strong opportunity because the Taiwan wireless-communication market source identifies LEO components and ground/user terminals as a 2026 growth engine, while lab evidence points to Starlink/Project Kuiper user-terminal RF validation, phased-array beamforming, mmWave, and MIMO high-frequency testing [2][89].  
4. Wi-Fi 7 / Wi-Fi-over-mmWave R&D is an evidence-backed but more inferential VNA opportunity because the vault directly supports Wi-Fi 7 growth and RF/antenna OTA test needs, while R&S ZNA evidence supports antenna-array test systems and mmWave converter use, but no passage directly says R&S ZNA is used for Wi-Fi 7 testing [2][60][73].

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R&S ZNA | Higher frequencies / mmWave / early 6G network infrastructure | R&S ZNA covers 26.5 GHz, 43.5 GHz, 50 GHz, and 67 GHz models, with frequency ranges from 10 MHz to 67 GHz, 2-port or 4-port base units, and optional mmWave converter support [64][65]. | The network-infrastructure mapping directly lists R&S ZNA under “Higher frequencies / mmWave / early 6G,” and the ZNA specs support high-frequency VNA coverage up to 67 GHz [43][65]. | Network drivers include “More Spectrum Bands / Higher Frequencies / Expanding Bandwidth,” and the solution mapping lists R&S ZNA for higher frequencies / mmWave / early 6G [44][43]. | The network-infrastructure source says the original PPTX needs checking for product connections, arrows, licenses/options, and test flow, so it is not a complete configuration or quotation basis [45]. |

- Specifications with limits：表示 warranted product performance；以 <、≤、>、≥、±、maximum、limit of、minimum 等符號標示；compliance 由 testing 確保或由 design 推導。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）：依 specifications with limits 指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，product performance 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：表示 warranted product performance；未特別標記時表示數值沒有或只有可忽略偏差。
- Typical data（typ.）：representative information；若標示 <、> 或 range，代表約 80% instruments 在 production time 可達成的 performance，其他情況代表 mean value。
- Nominal values（nom.）：representative value；production 期間不測試該 parameter。
- Measured values（meas.）：individual samples 的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor 2，依 Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement（GUM），並考量 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- 來源明確說明：non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。

無線裝置法規符合性測試 › 三類 approval testing
依 [[Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology]]，final products 需要三類 approval testing 才能 secure successful market access：

1. [[Regulatory Compliance Test]]：grant market access under legal aspect in each region。來源例子包含 [[CE RED 無線設備法規測試]]、[[FCC 無線設備法規測試]]。
2. [[Telecom Industry Certification Test]]：enable high quality, reliable, secure wireless communication。來源例子包含 [[GCF]] / Cellular、[[Bluetooth SIG]]、[[FiRa]] / [[UWB]]、[[Wi-Fi Alliance]] / Wi-Fi。
3. [[Cellular Network Operator Acceptance Test]]：demonstrate interoperability for specific features。來源例子包含 AT&T、VzW、T-mobile、CMCC。

來源特別強調其簡報 focus 是 regulatory compliance test，並聚焦 [[CE RED 無線設備法規測試]]與 [[FCC 無線設備法規測試]]。

Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology › 重點摘要
- 來源指出 smartphone Art 3.3g / [[Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019-320]] / E112 是沒有 ETSI EN standard 的 regulatory compliance requirement；當沒有 EN standard available 時需 Notified body involved，並稱 [[R&S TS-LBS]] 是 first test solution available to perform the necessary LBS compliance tests。
- [[FCC 無線設備法規測試]]部分列出 [[47 CFR]]、[[ANSI C63.26]]、[[ANSI C63.10]]、[[IEEE Std 1528-2013]]、[[C63.19]] 等測試依據，並列出 licensed cellular CFR47 test items：RF power output、modulation characteristics、occupied bandwidth、band edge、spurious emissions、frequency stability、peak to average ratio、field strength of spurious radiation。
- 來源以 [[ITU-R SM.329-12]] 與 [[47 CFR §2.1057]] 對照 CE RED / FCC 的 frequency range：5G NR FR1 的 CE RED 30 MHz–26 GHz、FCC 9 kHz–40 GHz；5G NR FR2 的 CE RED 30 MHz–90 GHz、FCC 9 kHz–200 GHz；並提到 [[R&S FSV3000]] / [[R&S FSVA3000]]、[[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S ESW]]。
- [[NTN 裝置法規測試]]部分把 NTN device implementation 分成 proprietary、3GPP < R16、3GPP R17 NTN-IoT、reuse spectrum assets / 3GPP unmodified UE 等路徑，例子包含 iPhone 14 / Globalstar、Qualcomm / Iridium、MTK / Bullitt / Skylo、AT&T / AST Space Mobile、T-Mobile / Starlink、Optus / Lynk。
- 來源列出衛星 / NTN 相關 EN standards：[[EN 301 441]]、[[EN 301 442]]、[[EN 301 444]]、[[EN 301 681]]、[[EN 302 574]]、[[EN 303 981]]，並將 iPhone14、Bullitt defy satellite link、StarLink Dish 作為 DoC / market product examples。
- 來源將 [[EN 301 681]] 測試偏向 conducted measurement，列出 spectrum analyzer、signal generator、BER measure / system emulator / mobile radio tester 等 required instruments，並明示 latest [[R&S CMW500]] software can support 3GPP R17 NB-NTN signalling。

Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology › 重點摘要
- 來源將 wireless products 的 market access approval testing 分成三類：[[Regulatory Compliance Test]]、[[Telecom Industry Certification Test]]、[[Cellular Network Operator Acceptance Test]]。Regulatory compliance 被描述為各區域法律面 market access 的必要條件；industry certification 例子包含 [[GCF]] / Cellular、[[Bluetooth SIG]]、[[FiRa]] / [[UWB]]、[[Wi-Fi Alliance]]；operator acceptance test 例子包含 AT&T、VzW、T-mobile、CMCC。
- 來源主張 wireless products 需要 [[CE marking]] / [[FCC ID]]；test results 是 technical documentation 的一部分，需在產品投放市場前準備、可提供給 surveillance authorities，並自 placed on the market 起保存 10 years。
- 來源列出 Ericsson Mobility Visualizer Jan 2023 的 mobile subscriptions 表，顯示 2022–2028 的 5G subscriptions 由 1046.006 增至 4974.568；但單位與表格數值口徑未在轉檔文字中完整標示。
- [[CE RED 無線設備法規測試]]被整理成四類 essential requirements：Art 3.1a Health & Safety、Art 3.1b EMC、Art 3.2 Radio Spectrum、Art 3.3 Specific topics。來源列出多個 ETSI EN standards，例如 [[EN 300 328]]、[[EN 301 893]]、[[EN 303 687]]、[[EN 301 908-1]]、[[EN 301 908-13]]、[[EN 301 908-24]]、[[EN 301 908-25]]、[[EN 301 489-52]] 等。
- 對 [[5G NR SAR testing]]，來源指出 5G NR network emulator is required to drive EUT to extreme transmission condition，multi-radio UE 的 average-SAR feature 需要 flexible signaling functions，涵蓋 cellular standards、Wi-Fi 與 Bluetooth；來源將 [[R&S CMW500]] / [[R&S CMX500]] 稱為 SAR / HAC signaling solution。
- 對 Art 3.1b EMC，來源指出 EMC tests 需要 radio enabled 與 radio disabled conditions，因此 5G NR 也需要 signaling solution；mobile phone 仍需要 [[Audio Breakthrough]] test，從 GSM 到 VoLTE / VoNR by 5G。來源提到 [[R&S TS9982 EMS Test System]] 與 [[R&S TS9975 EMI Test System]]。
- 對 Art 3.2 Radio Spectrum，來源指出 5G NR specification 包含 FR1 與 FR2；FR1 test setup stays conducted，FR2 test setup becomes radiated；並把 3GPP test cases、CTIA-OTA test cases、TRP / TRS、RSE 測試連到 [[R&S TS8991]] 與 [[R&S TS8996]]。

Wi-Fi over mmWave Technology › 測試需求
依 [[R&S for JIO Project]] 與 [[R&S solution for Jio project_202509_r3]]，WoMT 測試至少包含：

- OTA precision measurement：使用 [[R&S ATS1800C]] CATR chamber。
- TX analysis：[[EIRP]]、[[TRP]]、[[ACLR]]、EVM under Wi-Fi 7 modulation。
- RX analysis：[[EIS]] sensitivity verification。
- Spurious：Rx / OOB spurious emissions monitoring。
- Occupied bandwidth。
- Native Wi-Fi / IF / IB band：[[R&S CMP180]]。
- mmWave signal generation and analysis：[[R&S CMP200]] / [[R&S CMPHEAD50]]。
- R&D fine tuning：[[R&S FSW67]] 與 signal sources。
- Production / manufacturing setup：[[R&S CMQ200]] 與 automation SW WMT 只作為來源列名，尚無詳細流程。

Wi-Fi over mmWave Technology › 使用限制
- [[Wi-Fi over mmWave Technology]] 目前不是由正式標準文件建立的 concept；本頁只反映 [[R&S for JIO Project]] 與 [[R&S solution for Jio project_202509_r3]] 的 project-deck 說法。
- `Standard for Wi-Fi over mmWave (n257, n258)` 的版本、發布組織、適用地區、測試項目與認證流程未標示。
- 27 GHz 與 n257 / n258 的關係在來源中未以頻段表定義；不可自行補入 3GPP band tables。
- 來源沒有提供 throughput、range、modulation coding scheme、channel bandwidth、EIRP limit、TRP limit、EIS limit 或 spurious limit 數值。

- WoMT project 的完整描述出現在 slide 1：`Technical Achievements and Measurement Results for JIO WoMT Project`。

- Slide 3 說目前缺乏 Wi-Fi operating in mmWave bands 的 established global test standards。
- Slide 4 說 transmission principle 是透過 [[AiP]] modules 將 Wi-Fi 7 signals up-convert 到 27 GHz mmWave band。
- Slide 4 說 device types 包含 Integrated Radio CPEs 與 WoMT-AP（Access Point）。

- [[R&S CMP200]] 與 [[R&S CMPHEAD50]] 被放在 WIFI mmWave path。
- RD site 以 [[R&S ATS1800C]]、[[R&S FSW67]]、[[R&S SMM100A]] 做 Tx / Rx measurement。

JIO WiFi on mmWave › 與既有知識的關係

- [[Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing]]、[[4G 5G NR WLAN OTA MIMO stress testing]] 與 [[5G RedCap OTA measurements]] 已有 R&S / OTA partner PR 層級測試情境；本來源未明示 [[R&S CMX500]]、chamber、OTA、Wi-Fi 7 或 RedCap，因此不能直接連成相同測試方案。

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing › 可追溯範圍與限制
- 本頁目前由 [[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]]、[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 與 [[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 支撐。
- 本頁不推論 [[R&S CMX500]] 或 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 實際支援的 RF chains 數量、spatial streams 數量、MLO link combination、software option code 或 hardware configuration。

- [[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 使用 full compliance with [[IEEE 802.11be]] 的語句，但未展開 compliance 的測試項目、標準版本、認證機構或是否等同正式 conformance / certification testing。

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing › Wi-Fi 7 技術背景
[[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]] 列出的 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] throughput-related components 包含：

| 技術項目 | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| 320 MHz channel bandwidth | key component facilitating higher throughput |
| up to 16 spatial streams | key component facilitating higher throughput |
| 4096 QAM modulation | key component facilitating higher throughput |
| [[MLO]] | key component；also key feature making multiple RF chains important |

[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 提供 solution-level update：[[Bluetest]] earlier integrated WLAN testing capabilities 現在支援 [[Wi-Fi 7]] bandwidth up to **320 MHz**。

[[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 則以背景段落描述 [[IEEE 802.11be]] / [[Wi-Fi 7]] 是 next generation Wi-Fi technology，面向 extremely high data throughput、tens of gigabits per second、low latency、ultra-high-definition video streaming、virtual reality 與 augmented reality applications。

以上皆為來源對 Wi-Fi 7 與整合測試能力的敘述，不等同於 [[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S CMX500 OBT]]、[[Bluetest Flow]]、[[Bluetest]] RTS 或 [[EMITE]] chambers 對所有 feature combination 的完整規格保證。

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing › 為什麼需要 OTA 與 multiple RF chains
[[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]] 指出，在 WLAN devices development 期間，需要在 real-world conditions in signaling mode 下量測 antennas 以及 RF transmitter / receiver characteristics。由於 [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很關鍵。

同一來源同時將 [[R&S CMX500]] 描述為 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester；其 flexibility、support for multiple radio technologies 與 embedded IP test capabilities 使其可用於 broad range of Wi-Fi 7-specific tests。

[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 進一步把 Wi-Fi 7 OTA 測試放入更廣的 [[4G 5G NR WLAN OTA MIMO stress testing]] 情境：同一 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] / [[Bluetest]] RTS workflow 同時涵蓋 WiFi、[[LTE]]、5G SA / NSA 的 radio and antenna performance validation。

[[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 沒有使用 MIMO stress testing 一詞，也沒有提供 RF chains、spatial streams 或 chamber reflection model；它的貢獻是確認另一個 OTA chamber vendor [[EMITE]] 也將 [[R&S CMX500]] 整合到 [[Wi-Fi 7]] OTA measurement solution 中。

依 [[無線通訊認證實驗室]]：

- [[無線通訊認證實驗室]]用於測試與驗證無線設備符合法規、安全與性能標準，涵蓋 [[RF 測試]]、[[EMC]]、安規及一致性認證。
- 來源稱其可經 [[NCC]]、[[TAF]]、[[FCC]] 等機構認可，並支援 [[Global Market Access]] 與上市加速。
- 主要測試項目包含：頻譜、輸出功率、[[DFS]]、[[SAR]]、EMI / EMS、靜電放電、電源突波、[[Protocol 相容性]]、互操作性測試、[[PTCRB]] / [[GCF]] 認證。
- 認證必要性包含防止電磁干擾與頻譜衝突、保障用戶安全、加速上市、降低召回與法律風險，以及滿足台灣供應鏈衛星終端、6G 等需求。

The vault does not rank VNA opportunities, so the strongest opportunities below are the ones with the clearest combination of wireless-market demand, measurement need, and VNA/R&S product evidence rather than a verified ranking [44][43][48][65].
### 推薦先賣
1. Higher frequencies / mmWave / early 6G network infrastructure is the clearest VNA opportunity because the network-infrastructure solution mapping explicitly lists R&S ZNA and R&S ZNA67EXT for “Higher frequencies / mmWave / early 6G,” alongside mmWave front ends and frequency converters [43].  
2. Wireless regulatory and certification labs are a strong VNA opportunity because wireless products require approval testing for market access, and the regulatory-test source lists “network analyzer” among primary test instruments for wireless regulatory test labs [26][27][48].  
3. LEO satellite terminals, phased-array antennas, and high-frequency RF validation are a strong opportunity because the Taiwan wireless-communication market source identifies LEO components and ground/user terminals as a 2026 growth engine, while lab evidence points to Starlink/Project Kuiper user-terminal RF validation, phased-array beamforming, mmWave, and MIMO high-frequency testing [2][89].  
4. Wi-Fi 7 / Wi-Fi-over-mmWave R&D is an evidence-backed but more inferential VNA opportunity because the vault directly supports Wi-Fi 7 growth and RF/antenna OTA test needs, while R&S ZNA evidence supports antenna-array test systems and mmWave converter use, but no passage directly says R&S ZNA is used for Wi-Fi 7 testing [2][60][73].  
### 產品與 Option 對接表

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R&S ZNA | Higher frequencies / mmWave / early 6G network infrastructure | R&S ZNA covers 26.5 GHz, 43.5 GHz, 50 GHz, and 67 GHz models, with frequency ranges from 10 MHz to 67 GHz, 2-port or 4-port base units, and optional mmWave converter support [64][65]. | The network-infrastructure mapping directly lists R&S ZNA under “Higher frequencies / mmWave / early 6G,” and the ZNA specs support high-frequency VNA coverage up to 67 GHz [43][65]. | Network drivers include “More Spectrum Bands / Higher Frequencies / Expanding Bandwidth,” and the solution mapping lists R&S ZNA for higher frequencies / mmWave / early 6G [44][43]. | The network-infrastructure source says the original PPTX needs checking for product connections, arrows, licenses/options, and test flow, so it is not a complete configuration or quotation basis [45]. |
| R&S ZNA67EXT | Sub-THz / 110 GHz extension for mmWave and early-6G-style work | R&S ZNA67EXT is a Vector Network Analyzer System with 110 GHz complete-system variants based on R&S ZNA67 and millimeterwave converter heads [38]. | The same network-infrastructure mapping explicitly lists R&S ZNA67EXT for “Higher frequencies / mmWave / early 6G,” and the product page confirms 110 GHz system variants [43][38]. | R&S ZNA67EXT ordering information lists 110 GHz, 2-port and 4-port complete systems with standard-power and high-power variants [38]. | The vault does not provide a customer use case, application note, or required option stack tying each ZNA67EXT variant to a specific wireless standard or certification test [38][45]. |

| LEO satellite user-terminal and phased-array antenna validation | R&S ZNA 4-port architecture and mmWave converter support as a characterization platform, with lab/chamber integration details not specified [73][72]. | Lead with LEO supply-chain growth, ground/user terminals involving phased-array antennas, Ku/Ka-band, RF front-end and system integration, and lab evidence for Starlink/Project Kuiper RF validation and phased-array beamforming tests [2][89]. | The vault warns not to rewrite these lab slides as verified Starlink/Kuiper certification services, customer cases, or complete test capabilities [89]. |

| Wi-Fi 7 / Wi-Fi-over-mmWave R&D and ODM labs | Treat R&S ZNA as a possible RF/antenna-array characterization add-on rather than the primary Wi-Fi 7 signaling tester, because the direct Wi-Fi 7 OTA evidence centers on CMX500/OTA workflows rather than VNA [60][73]. | Lead with Wi-Fi 7 ODM growth, 320 MHz channel bandwidth, 4096-QAM, MLO, 6 GHz, and Taiwan 6 GHz opening, then separate that from VNA antenna-array test-system capability [2][73]. | No passage directly maps R&S ZNA to Wi-Fi 7 certification, Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing, or Wi-Fi-over-mmWave project test setups [52][58][60]. |
### 限制
The vault supports “opportunity” only as an evidence-based sales hypothesis unless a passage directly maps a VNA product to the wireless use case, and the clearest direct mapping is for R&S ZNA/R&S ZNA67EXT in higher frequencies / mmWave / early 6G [43].  
【推論】The best-supported first sales motion is R&S ZNA / R&S ZNA67EXT for mmWave and early-6G infrastructure because one source names the wireless driver and maps R&S ZNA/R&S ZNA67EXT to that scenario, while product sources confirm ZNA up to 67 GHz and ZNA67EXT 110 GHz variants [44][43][65][38].  
【推論】The second-best evidenced motion is certification and LEO-terminal labs because the vault shows mandatory wireless market-access testing and lists network analyzer as a primary lab instrument, while separate LEO lab evidence names user-terminal RF validation, phased-array beamforming, mmWave, and MIMO testing [27][48][89].  
【推論】Wi-Fi 7 is a promising but less directly proven VNA motion because the vault supports Wi-Fi 7 market and antenna/RF OTA needs, but the cited Wi-Fi 7 test evidence does not directly name R&S ZNA or another VNA as the Wi-Fi 7 test instrument [2][60][58].

- OTA precision measurement：使用 [[R&S ATS1800C]] CATR chamber。
- TX analysis：[[EIRP]]、[[TRP]]、[[ACLR]]、EVM under Wi-Fi 7 modulation。
- RX analysis：[[EIS]] sensitivity verification。
- Spurious：Rx / OOB spurious emissions monitoring。
- Occupied bandwidth。
- Native Wi-Fi / IF / IB band：[[R&S CMP180]]。
- mmWave signal generation and analysis：[[R&S CMP200]] / [[R&S CMPHEAD50]]。
- R&D fine tuning：[[R&S FSW67]] 與 signal sources。
- Production / manufacturing setup：[[R&S CMQ200]] 與 automation SW WMT 只作為來源列名，尚無詳細流程。

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing › 可追溯範圍與限制
- 本頁目前由 [[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]]、[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 與 [[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 支撐。
- 本頁不推論 [[R&S CMX500]] 或 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 實際支援的 RF chains 數量、spatial streams 數量、MLO link combination、software option code 或 hardware configuration。
- 本頁不推論 [[Bluetest RTS65]]、其他 Bluetest RTS chambers 或 [[EMITE]] OTA chambers 的完整規格、measurement uncertainty、校準流程或 certification applicability。
- 本頁不把新聞稿中的 solution positioning 視為 conformance test coverage 或正式規格。
- [[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 標示 [[Bluetest Flow]] v1.18，但未提供 release date、release notes、license requirement 或相容性矩陣。
- [[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 使用 full compliance with [[IEEE 802.11be]] 的語句，但未展開 compliance 的測試項目、標準版本、認證機構或是否等同正式 conformance / certification testing。

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing › 為什麼需要 OTA 與 multiple RF chains
[[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]] 指出，在 WLAN devices development 期間，需要在 real-world conditions in signaling mode 下量測 antennas 以及 RF transmitter / receiver characteristics。由於 [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很關鍵。

同一來源同時將 [[R&S CMX500]] 描述為 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester；其 flexibility、support for multiple radio technologies 與 embedded IP test capabilities 使其可用於 broad range of Wi-Fi 7-specific tests。

[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 進一步把 Wi-Fi 7 OTA 測試放入更廣的 [[4G 5G NR WLAN OTA MIMO stress testing]] 情境：同一 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] / [[Bluetest]] RTS workflow 同時涵蓋 WiFi、[[LTE]]、5G SA / NSA 的 radio and antenna performance validation。

[[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 沒有使用 MIMO stress testing 一詞，也沒有提供 RF chains、spatial streams 或 chamber reflection model；它的貢獻是確認另一個 OTA chamber vendor [[EMITE]] 也將 [[R&S CMX500]] 整合到 [[Wi-Fi 7]] OTA measurement solution 中。

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 關鍵實體與概念
- [[R&S ZNA]] — Vector Network Analyzer 系列，涵蓋 26.5 GHz、43.5 GHz、50 GHz、67 GHz 型號。
- [[R&S ZNA26]] — 26.5 GHz 型號，3.5 mm ruggedized male connector。
- [[R&S ZNA43]] — 43.5 GHz 型號，2.92 mm 或 2.4 mm ruggedized male connector。
- [[R&S ZNA50]] — 50 GHz 型號，2.4 mm ruggedized male connector。
- [[R&S ZNA67]] — 67 GHz 型號，1.85 mm ruggedized male connector。
- [[Vector Network Analyzer]]、[[Dynamic range]]、[[Measurement bandwidth]]、[[Direct source and receiver access]]、[[Noise figure measurement]]、[[mmWave converter support]]、[[Phase-coherent source control]]、[[Health and utilization monitoring service]]、[[Time domain analysis]]、[[Deembedding]]。

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 重點摘要
- 型號頻率範圍：
  - [[R&S ZNA26]]：10 MHz to 26.5 GHz。
  - [[R&S ZNA43]]：10 MHz to 43.5 GHz，可為 2.92 mm 或 2.4 mm ruggedized male test port connector。
  - [[R&S ZNA50]]：10 MHz to 50 GHz。
  - [[R&S ZNA67]]：10 MHz to 67 GHz。
- 各型號提供 2 ports 或 4 ports base unit；test port impedance 為 50 Ω，DC block 為 standard。
- Key performance 包含：dynamic range > 129 dB specification without options、147 dB typical with options、maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction；sensitivity > –120 dBm at 1 Hz IF bandwidth specification without options，並有 –162 dBm measured with options（1 kHz measurement bandwidth normalized to 1 Hz）。
- Measurement bandwidth：base unit 1 Hz to 1.5 MHz；搭配 [[R&S ZNA-K17]] increased IF bandwidth 30 MHz option 時為 1 Hz to 30 MHz。
- Measurement speed 條件包含 firmware version 3.20、Windows 11 (64 bit)；例：10 MHz to 43.5 GHz、500 kHz measurement bandwidth、1601 points、2-port calibration 時 sweep time 96 ms nominal。
- 4-port instruments：最多 4 sources，independently configurable、phase coherent、phase controlled；另有第 5 source 可作為 LO supply；每 port 有 2 true receivers，4-port model 總計 8 true receivers，無 multiplexing。
- 2-port instruments：最多 2 sources，independently configurable、phase coherent、phase controlled；另有第 3 source 可作為 LO supply；每 port 有 2 true receivers，2-port model 總計 4 true receivers，無 multiplexing。
- Optional rear panel LO out 可支援 mmWave converters；4-port model 最多 4 個 converters，2-port model 最多 2 個 converters，無需 external signal generator；rear panel LO out typ. +25 dBm，最高 26.5 GHz。
- [[R&S ZNA-K28]] continuous data recording 支援 infinite data point capture、circular buffer，並可透過 LAN 或 USB 連續資料傳輸。
- [[R&S ZNA-B26]] direct IF access：IF input 可用於 mmWave converter 與 antenna measurement systems，bandwidth 1 GHz；IF output up to 2 GHz bandwidth 可用於 external pulse analysis。

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 原文未解的問題
- 來源有列出大量 options、accessories 與相依關係；本次 wiki 摘要保留主要可報價項目的 code、order no.、名稱與原文相依關係，但未逐字展開所有 calibration accessories、test cables、switch matrix extensions 的完整規格表。
- 部分表格同時出現 spec.、typ.、meas. 或 nom. 數值；本摘要依原文標示保留，不自行調和。
- 來源註明 Internal PC is subject to change without notice；因此 internal PC 規格需以此 Version 24.00（April 2026）為準。
- [[R&S ZNA-K121]] RF off boot up 在本次來源摘錄中列出名稱，但未提供 Order No.；頁面標示為來源未標示。
- 讀圖補充 p050 的尺寸數值旁單位無法辨識；不得推論為 mm 或其他單位。
- 本次輸入摘錄未提供讀圖頁面的圖片嵌入 wikilink，故 wiki 無法帶入原圖供核對。

R&S ZNA › 重要 recommended setups
- [[R&S ZNA-K5]] vector corrected converter measurements：recommended setup 為 4-port R&S®ZNA；需要 R&S®ZNA-K4、R&S®ZNA-B5、R&S®ZNA-B8 mmWave converter LO、R&S®ZN-ZM292 calibration mixer 與 calibration accessories。
- [[R&S ZNA-K8]] mmWave converter support：two mmWave converters with 2-port R&S®ZNA，或 four mmWave converters with 4-port R&S®ZNA；需要 R&S®ZNA-K8、R&S®ZNA-B8、R&S®ZNA-B26、R&S®ZCAKN 與 accessories。Alternative setup：two mmWave converters with 4-port R&S®ZNA，需要 R&S®ZNA-K8、R&S®ZNAxx-B16、R&S®ZCAKN 與 accessories。
- [[R&S ZNA-K9]] group delay measurements：4-port R&S®ZNA recommended setup 需要 R&S®ZNAxx-B213、R&S®ZNA-B5、R&S®ZNA-K9；2-port R&S®ZNA recommended setup 需要 R&S®ZNAxx-B212、R&S®ZNAxx-B52、R&S®ZNA-K9。
- [[R&S ZNA-K30]] noise figure measurement：recommended setup 使用 port 1 as driving and port 2 as receiving port；需要 R&S®ZNAxx-B16、R&S®ZNAxx-B21、R&S®ZNAxx-B32、R&S®ZNAxx-B161、R&S®ZNAxx-B302、diode power sensor（例如 R&S®NRP40S）與 accessories（test cables、fixed attenuators 3 dB / 6 dB / 10 dB 等）。

R&S ZNA › 2-port / 4-port 架構
依 [[ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400]]（Version 24.00, April 2026）：

- 4-port instruments：最多 4 sources，independently configurable、phase coherent、phase controlled；另有第 5 source 可作為 LO supply。
- 2-port instruments：最多 2 sources，independently configurable、phase coherent、phase controlled；另有第 3 source 可作為 LO supply。
- 4-port model 每 port 有 2 true receivers，總計 8 true receivers；2-port model 每 port 有 2 true receivers，總計 4 true receivers；來源明確說明無 multiplexing。
- 支援 true parallel and coherent data acquisition，例如 antenna array tests 與 antenna test systems，從 100 kHz 開始。
- Optional rear panel LO out 可支援 mmWave converters；4-port model 最多 4 個 converters，2-port model 最多 2 個 converters，無需 external signal generator。
- Rear panel LO out 提供 high-power LO signal，typ. +25 dBm，最高 26.5 GHz，可作為 mixer measurements 的 LO source。
- Optional second LO source 可讓 mixer/frequency convertor measurements 速度加倍並最佳化 trace noise。
- 使用 [[R&S ZNA-K9]] option、1 kHz measurement bandwidth 時，mixer group delay 與 deviation from linear phase 的 group delay trace noise peak-to-peak 可由 200 ps 降至 15 ps。
- 最多 4 pulse modulators、最多 8 pulse generators（4-port）；最多 2 pulse modulators、最多 4 pulse generators（2-port）。
- Minimum pulse width：40 ns。
- Optional direct IF access（in/out）：IF input 可用於 mmWave converter 與 antenna measurement systems，bandwidth 1 GHz；IF output up to 2 GHz bandwidth 可用於 external pulse analysis。
- Selectable reference signal access：1 GHz external reference，可同步 external equipment，例如 signal generators，改善 mmWave converters up to terahertz frequencies 的 performance。
